claim_corroborated_as_duplicate_of_confi.means: the same claim was accepted as a confirmed/acknowledged finding in the same audit, so the underlying issue is real and only this copy was redundant
claim_corroborated_as_duplicate_of_confi.note: graded by method: an explicit `duplicate_of` pointer that resolves to a published finding is high confidence, an identical normalised title in the same audit is medium, a shared code target or similar snippet is context only. Corroboration supports `is_false_positive: false` for the underlying issue; it never supports a technical reason

exploit_attempted_and_claimed_violation_.means: an exploit was reconstructed and executed against the pinned revision and the claimed violation was not observed
exploit_attempted_and_claimed_violation_.note: the only class that can establish a false positive by experiment. Where the attack was executed and succeeded, the record states the underlying issue is real rather than calling anything disproven

reason_attributed_to_judge_or_sponsor.means: a named judge or the sponsor published a statement, carried verbatim with author, role, URL and excerpt hash, that addresses this submission
reason_attributed_to_judge_or_sponsor.note: split by rule into a technical refutation and a design-intent/scope exclusion; participant (warden) replies are excluded — they are discussion, not an adjudicated reason

reason_supported_by_cited_code.means: a guard mechanically located on the function the submission says the attacker calls removes the standing the submission's own text claims
reason_supported_by_cited_code.note: requires the gate on the CLAIM'S OWN TARGET plus a claim that asserts an actor lacking that role; a gate elsewhere, or a claim about a privileged actor, is recorded as context only

rejection_status_publicly_reported.means: the contest page publicly records a status for this submission (duplicate / rejected / disputed / invalid / withdrawn / nullified / ineligible)
rejection_status_publicly_reported.note: this is the weakest useful statement: it is a fact about the contest record, not a reason the claim is false

unknown_or_insufficient_evidence.means: only a rejection, duplicate or dispute label is public, no attributed reason exists, no gate refutes the claim's own standing, and no exploit was attempted
unknown_or_insufficient_evidence.note: unknown_or_insufficient_evidence is a valid answer, not a failure of the pipeline; it is reported with the blocker that applies (pointer unresolved, environment unavailable, no public statement)

metrics_sum_note: these six metrics are independent axes and are NOT additive: one record can appear in several of them
seed_provenance: Every row in this layer comes from a public Code4rena contest record in `jsonl/negative_findings.jsonl`. No artefact of a report the dataset builder submitted to a bounty programme exists in this project, and none was invented to reach 458-plus records: seeding one would require the actual source artefact plus a check of the programme's publication and confidentiality terms, and personal details would have to be anonymised first.
